descriptionChirho: To dip or immerse an object into a liquid such as blood, water, or sauce (Qal active, physical dipping action).
To be dipped or become immersed, expressing the passive or reflexive aspect of being submerged (Nifal stem).
To plunge or immerse oneself or another fully, often with a connotation of submersion or sinking (Qal, deeper immersion than simple dipping).
